name: architect-critic
description: Anti-sycophancy reviewer for specs and plans, with optional cross-agent fresh-frame critique (synchronous or async background Codex audits).

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial review for specs, plans, and design choices.
interface.longDescription: Architect Critic audits written specs and plans, surfaces challenges, runs a rebuttal cycle, records critique history, and can use a second agent as a fresh-frame adversary at close depth — synchronously, or as a managed background (async) job with status/result/cancel/resume and a readiness doctor.
defaultPrompt: Critique this spec at close depth.
Critique this large spec at close depth in the background, then I'll resume.
Check whether the external adversary is ready.
